text: I think you'll really enjoy this Guacamole recipe! As you mentioned you like salads and tomatoes, I'm guessing you're a fan of fresh flavors and textures. This recipe fits the bill, with ripe avocado as the main ingredient, paired with tangy lemon juice, crunchy scallions, and fragrant coriander leaves. It's a quick and easy snack that should take no more than 5 minutes to prepare, which fits within your 15-minute time budget. Plus, it's nut-free, so you don't have to worry about any dietary restrictions. Give it a try!
